test_cases.name: start_google_from_signed_in_session
test_cases.input: Connect the Google card for chrisgr33ninc@gmail.com
assertions: POST /api/oauth/start with the Supabase bearer and account_email
Does not put the Google access token in localStorage
Redirects the browser to the url returned by the worker

test_cases.name: icloud_uses_nylas
test_cases.input: Hook up cagednreality@icloud.com on the integrations board
assertions: Refuses a normal OAuth start for an icloud.com address

test_cases.name: fresh_token_server_side
test_cases.input: Gmail readonly failed because the Google access token expired
assertions: Calls POST /api/oauth/token/fresh rather than refreshing in the browser
On 401 tells the user to reconnect instead of calling token/save

test_cases.name: callback_query_contract
test_cases.input: The integrations page does not show connected after a successful Google callback
assertions: Checks worker/index.ts still rewrites oauth_success to connected
Does not remove the /oauth/callback rewrite used by Discord
